cover.title: what your signup page is hiding

inner.title: kill the popup
inner.body: mobbin sent gated visitors to its full signup page instead of a bare popup. sign-ups rose 12%, so your modal is losing people your page would win.
inner.label: +12% signups

inner.title: the card question
inner.body: innertrends benchmarks put card-upfront trials at 1% of visitors, against 2% without a card. but 60% of card trials pay, against 25%.
inner.label: pick one

inner.title: loosen password rules
inner.body: baymard found 82% of sites demand needlessly complex passwords. nist's minimum is 8 characters, and every extra rule is a reason to leave.
inner.label: 82% of sites

inner.title: the reset email
inner.body: returning users who forget a password have to wait for a reset email. in baymard tests, up to 19% abandoned checkout over reset issues alone.
inner.label: 19% gone

inner.title: make accounts optional
inner.body: 37% of shoppers in baymard's 2017 survey disliked being forced to make an account. sites that drop the requirement see 10 to 30% more conversions.
inner.label: 37% hate it

closer.HEADLINE:
your signup page isn't a form.
it's a filter
closer.TONIGHT: sign up to your own product
closer.CTA: comment card if you ask for it upfront
